item.jaymoskingdoms.captured_plans.of: The plans of %s, taken with it
item.jaymoskingdoms.captured_plans.how: Use them to copy the place among your designs.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captured_plans.be: You can't make these plans out until %s is open to you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captured_plans.lo: These plans have faded past reading.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captured_plans.co: The plans of %s are copied as design %s (%s x %s, %s high, %s blocks), drawn on a building plan.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captured_plans.cr: Lay the plan out and fill it, have a mason's table build it, or offer it to your settlement at one and its builders will put it up.
